display.purpose: Hero wordmark only, uppercase on two lines, second line gold. WoE title uses the same voice at clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 5rem)/0.95.

headline.purpose: Section titles; closing sections scale it up or down.

title.purpose: Claim titles and smaller display moments (realm names, fact values, WoE quote).

subhead.purpose: Small block heads such as Estado en vivo, Próxima WoE, Castillos.

body.purpose: Default text; ledes at 1.0625rem in muted parchment, 32 to 38rem measure.

button.purpose: All button labels; 1rem in the large size.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked metadata: hero meta line, character labels, table heads, countdown units (0.75 to 0.8125rem, +0.06 to +0.14em).

shadows.name: focus-well
shadows.purpose: Focused input, paired with a gold border.

shadows.name: status-halo
shadows.purpose: Online status dot; crimson rgba(194, 58, 69, 0.15) when offline.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: House easing for every transform transition.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and button scale transitions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Nav underline, claim title nudge, Novice label reveal, disclosure chevrons.

motion.name: tab-ink
motion.purpose: Rankings tab slab slide and resize.

motion.name: novice-go
motion.purpose: Novice click salute and leap before scrolling to its section.

motion.name: novice-idle
motion.purpose: Staggered idle loops on each Novice.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: pointer x 14px, y 8px, scroll 0.18 per depth unit
motion.purpose: Hero scene layers; fine pointers only for pointer parallax.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold fill for the main action in a viewport or block.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem; font: 600 1rem/1.1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #ece7dd; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms, border-color 160ms, color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); transition-duration: 60ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4b06a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { color: #17130a; background: #d4b06a; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(212, 176, 106, 0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e8cc8f; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(232, 204, 143, 0.7); }

components.css: .ds-btn3 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.9rem 0.5rem; font: 600 1rem/1.1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #b4afa5; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn3:hover { color: #ece7dd; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn3:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4b06a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; max-width: 20rem; font-family: "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #b4afa5; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; font: 400 1rem/1.3 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ece7dd; background: #101217; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.2); border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 160ms, background-color 160ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.32); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #d4b06a; background: #161920; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212, 176, 106, 0.18); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #c23a45; } .ds-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #8a867e; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: rgba(11, 12, 15, 0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.1); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; color: #d4b06a; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand span { font: 400 1.125rem/1 "Faculty Glyphic", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #ece7dd; } .ds-brand em { font-style: normal; color: #d4b06a; } .ds-nav ul { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0 0 0 auto; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav ul a { position: relative; display: block; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #b4afa5; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 160ms; } .ds-nav ul a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0.8rem; right: 0.8rem; bottom: 0.15rem; height: 1px; background: #d4b06a; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav ul a:hover, .ds-nav ul a[aria-current] { color: #ece7dd; } .ds-nav ul a:hover::after, .ds-nav ul a[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav ul a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4b06a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #17130a; background: #d4b06a; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -10px rgba(212, 176, 106, 0.55); transition: background-color 160ms; } .ds-nav-play:hover { background: #e8cc8f; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem; background: #101217; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #b4afa5; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms, background-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #ece7dd; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: #17130a; background: #d4b06a; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4b06a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hairline Stat Rows

components.css: .ds-stats { margin: 0; max-width: 26rem; font-family: "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ece7dd; } .ds-stats div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.1); } .ds-stats dt { color: #b4afa5; } .ds-stats dd { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-num { font: 600 1.5rem/1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-dot { width: 0.6rem; height: 0.6rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #6cc58a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(108, 197, 138, 0.15); }

components.css: .ds-novice { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-guide-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font: 600 0.8125rem/1 "Onest", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ece7dd; background: rgba(16, 18, 23, 0.82); border: 1px solid rgba(236, 231, 221, 0.1); border-radius: 999px; opacity: 0.72; transform: translateY(3px); transition: opacity 160ms, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 160ms; } .ds-guide-label svg { color: #d4b06a; } .ds-novice:hover .ds-guide-label { opacity: 1; transform: none; border-color: rgba(212, 176, 106, 0.45); } .ds-novice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4b06a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-novice:focus-visible .ds-guide-label { opacity: 1; transform: none; border-color: #d4b06a; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a night hill facing a lit castle under siege. Everything else is quiet so that scene can speak: a near-black charcoal ground, graphite planes used sparingly, warm off-white text, and two disciplined accents. Emperium gold marks what the visitor should do or remember (the primary action, key numerals, focus, the selected tab). Banner crimson belongs to the war and to live state: the WoE band, its countdown rules, castle dividers, the offline dot, invalid fields. Nothing else is coloured.

Structure is carried by hairlines and space, not by boxes. Content lists are rows divided by 1px rules at 10% off-white; sections breathe on a large clamped rhythm; containers are rare and quiet. Display type is Faculty Glyphic, a slightly carved fantasy serif that says Ragnarok without costume; everything a player reads to act is set in Onest, modern and plain. The cinematic layer lives in authored SVG and a light ember canvas behind the hero, with subtle pointer and scroll parallax that never touches legibility, and a band of original pixel-art job characters (Novice, Swordman, Mage, Merchant) who act as the hero's navigation. Owner-supplied official Ragnarok Online art appears framed in the WoE and community sections, always credited to Gravity.

The system refuses the old private-server page (banners, bevelled buttons, dense tables of colour) and the generic dark gaming template (neon glows, glassy card grids, six feature tiles).
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (`color-scheme: dark`); charcoal ground, graphite used for inputs, tab tracks and selected states.
Gold is scarce and meaningful; crimson is reserved for war and live state.
Hairline-ruled rows instead of cards; generous clamped section spacing.
Faculty Glyphic for display and numerals, Onest for all functional text.

Authored SVG for the scene and a single-stroke icon set; pixel-art PNG sprite sheets for the job characters (rendered with `image-rendering: pixelated` at 2x or 3x); official art only as framed, captioned figures.
Motion is small, eased (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), and fully disabled under reduced motion.
Illustrative data is always marked with a dashed sample badge; unavailable actions render as disabled buttons that say why.

rules.name: The Gold Means Act Rule
rules.body: Gold fills only the primary action and the active tab. Elsewhere gold is a stroke, a numeral or a word, never a surface.

rules.name: The Crimson Is War Rule
rules.body: Crimson appears only in the WoE world and in live or error state. A crimson accent on a generic section is off-system.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Faculty Glyphic names and counts things; Onest instructs. Buttons, forms, tables and stats are never set in the display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Any changing number (players, uptime, levels, schedule times) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Box Rule
rules.body: Separate content with 1px rules at `hairline` or `hairline-strong`. Reach for a filled container only for controls (inputs, tab track, segmented control) or one closing call to action.

rules.name: The Scene Carries Depth Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric gradients, glows, smoke and embers live in the authored scene and the WoE band. UI surfaces stay flat.

dos: Do keep gold to the primary action, the active tab, key numerals, the wordmark accent and focus.
Do keep crimson to the WoE world, the offline state and invalid fields.
Do divide lists and stats with 1px hairlines and let section spacing (`clamp(5rem, 11vw, 9rem)`) do the grouping.
Do set names, titles and big numbers in Faculty Glyphic at weight 400, and every control, form, table and stat in Onest.
Do mark illustrative data with the dashed sample badge, and render unavailable actions as disabled buttons with a note.
Do draw icons from the single-stroke 24px set (1.6 stroke, round caps) and colour them with `currentColor`.
Do ease all state changes with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 160 to 260ms, and switch off animation under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't build grids of feature cards or glassy panels; content lives in ruled rows and columns.
Don't add drop shadows to surfaces; the gold under-glow belongs to the primary button alone.
Don't put gradients on controls or text; gradients belong to the scene, the WoE band and the one closing panel.
Don't bold the display face or set body copy in it.
Don't introduce another accent hue; new states reuse gold, crimson or green by meaning.
